items.title: Egypt reforms obsolete pharmaceutical pricing framework
items.summary: In late September 2026, the Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) published Decree No.480 of 2026 in the Official Gazette.

items.title: Gilead spends $1.28bn on PepStar’s potential Icotyde rival
items.summary: Gilead plans to develop HCXT-2001 both as a monotherapy and in combination with its own IBD hopeful, emvistegrast.

items.title: Boehringer and Microsoft collaborate to explore AI in clinical research
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and Microsoft have entered into a strategic collaboration to examine the use of AI in clinical research, beginning with studies in lung health.

items.title: Celltrion and Kaigene sign $580m licence deal for KG013
items.summary: Celltrion has acquired exclusive global development and commercialisation rights to Kaigene's investigational monoclonal antibody, KG013, in a deal worth up to $580m.

items.title: Building the next generation of sustainable data centres in pharma
items.summary: With the AI revolution underway, sustainability is now a key consideration for pharma companies building and utilising data centres.
